# Automotive Garage Management System - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Vue 3 + TypeScript application for managing an automotive garage with customer tracking, parts inventory, service scheduling, and service interval notifications.

## Completed Steps
- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements - Vue 3 application for automotive garage management
- [x] Scaffold the Project - Created Vue 3 + Vite project structure
- [x] Customize the Project - Added all required components and features
- [x] Install Required Extensions - No additional extensions needed
- [x] Compile the Project - Dependencies installed and build verified
- [x] Create and Run Task - Development server running
- [x] Launch the Project - Application running at http://localhost:5173
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete - README finalized

## Project Features
- ✅ Customer tracking with vehicle information
- ✅ Parts inventory and order management
- ✅ Service appointment scheduling
- ✅ Service interval notifications and alerts (with visual highlighting)
- ✅ Dashboard with overview of all operations
- ✅ Responsive design for all screen sizes
- ✅ Sample data for immediate testing

## Quick Start
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Visit http://localhost:5173 to see the application.
